text:
rachel: Quick thread to finalize the Cross-Route Fallback + Billing Reconciliation playbook for catalog migrations. Need concrete ops steps we can hand to SRE + Billing.
omar: Top priorities? Fallback selection logic, billing-safe windows, reconciliation steps, and per-route policies.
devon: Also include a deterministic tie-breaker when multiple fallback variants are compatible. We should prefer same-family quantized variants, then lower-cost family, then last-known-good.
rachel: Agreed. Draft fallback priority: 1) pinned variant (if tenant pinned) 2) same-family highest-compat 3) cross-family quantized 4) last-rolled-back stable.
sasha: Add a compatibility score calculation: structural match (vocab/dims) = 40, KV-cache-compat = 25, latency delta estimate = 20, quality delta estimate = 15. Pick fallback with highest score > 65.
devon: Example pseudo:
```
score = (structural_match?40:0) + (kv_compat?25:0) + (latency_est <= +20%?20:0) + (quality_est <= +2%?15:0)
if score >= 65 -> candidate fallback
else -> escalate to manual routing (pin enforcement or regional fallback)
```
omar: Billing safety: during a rollback window we must prevent double-billing and avoid charging tenants for speculative tokens generated by canary traffic. Propose: billing_pause scope = rollout_id + affected_tenants, auto-unpause only after reconciliation job completes.
rachel: Reconciliation job tasks: compute token delta between candidate & baseline for affected requests, mark provisional credits, generate adjustment CSV for Finance. Must be idempotent if rerun.
sasha: Include a short rollback & billing sequence for oncall: 1) Pause canary traffic 2) Route affected routes to fallback 3) Pause billing for affected tenants 4) Trigger reconciliation job 5) Open customer comms ticket (auto-template) 6) Postmortem.
devon: CLI snippets:
```sh
# pause traffic for rollout
redwoodctl traffic pause --rollout 84321 --scope tenants:acme
# route to fallback variant
redwoodctl traffic route --rollout 84321 --to catalog:ceres:v2-fq
# pause billing for scope
redwoodctl billing pause --scope rollout:84321
```
omar: For recon job: need metrics inputs -> token_count_by_request, route_map, fallback_map, pricing_tier. Output -> provisional_credit_pct per tenant + audit log.
rachel: We should expose a "billing-preview" run in Console before large rollouts so Sales/Finance can see potential impact. Add a button: Run billing preview for rollout.
sasha: Comms templates: short template for PRE (72h), LAUNCH banner + in-console note, ROLLBACK incident message, and POST (apology + credit summary + remediation timeline). Keep templates modular and reference rollout_id.
devon: Edge case: stateful sessions where KV cache mismatch causes silent degradation. Playbook: detect KV-miss rate > 0.2% -> trigger immediate compatibility check and, if unresolved in 15m, route those tenants to fallback. Also include a cache-warm API to help restore state.
omar: Telemetry hooks: label requests by rollout_id + route_variant and emit per-tenant eval probe pass/fail counts. Dashboards should show realtime delta for p50/p95, error-rate, kv-miss-rate, and per-tenant eval probes.
rachel: Escalation matrix: auto-rollback if thresholds breached; if manual override required, page SRE -> Product -> Legal (only if pin conflicts) -> Finance for billing exceptions.
sasha: Migration credits policy suggestion: small regressions (1-2%) -> auto 2% provisional credit; moderate (2-4%) -> 5% + prioritized remediation; severe (>4%) -> negotiated larger credit + dedicated fix. Credits only finalize after reconciliation job.
devon: Testing the playbook: run canary dry-run monthly per-family. Dry-run includes fallback selection simulation and billing-preview with synthetic traffic.
omar: Security note: fallback routing must respect tenant data residency and compliance (no cross-region fallback for restricted tenants). Add region constraint into fallback scorer.
rachel: Action items: Omar -> implement fallback scorer prototype & CLI flags by Wed; Devon -> add billing-preview endpoint + reconcile job stub by Thu; Sasha -> write comm templates and postmortem skeleton by Fri. I'll collate into a single playbook doc and schedule a short runbook dry-run next Tue.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout 84321 for catalog:ceres:v3 started in shadow at 2024-03-12T14:08Z.
rachel: Thanks all — drop gaps here. We'll validate with Finance before the next big migration. :white_check_mark:
